review_questions: Do list/create/resend/revoke require an active exact-workspace owner across web, REST, MCP, and personal-token principals, with removed/member/foreign callers denied through the shared CT-135 service?
Can a non-browser caller omit or spoof inviterEmail to self-invite, or can a malformed/missing hosted-user record fail open?

Can any raw invitation secret appear in Firestore, audit/event/idempotency data, logs, request URLs, HTML, or owner list responses outside the intended one-time response and browser fragment/POST-body flow?
Are create/resend/revoke/accept retry-safe and conflict-safe, with Firestore reads before writes and no partial mutation/evidence state under repository failure?

Do current, superseded, revoked, and used tokens maintain exact digest/workspace/invitation/version/expiry/state invariants, including after multiple resends, expiry, revoke, accept, and tampered/cross-linked ledger records?
Does wrong-email Google acceptance remain enumeration-safe and non-consuming, while revoked, expired, superseded, already-used, unknown, and malformed secrets have the documented safe outcomes?

Can concurrent or replayed correct acceptance create more than one active membership, reactivation revision, active-seat addition, or first-acceptance event, including when the user is already active or removed?

Do pending invitations remain outside the active membership/seat quantity and does the evidence contract allow O-202 to count only valid first acceptance without leaking email or overclaiming outcomes?
Do Firestore rules keep invitation, token, idempotency, product-event, and mutation-audit collections completely client-private while preserving CT-135 valid membership behavior?

Does the hosted UI show inviter, workspace, invited email, expiry, member role, pending-seat meaning, wrong-account sign-out/retry, and distinct terminal recovery states with keyboard-complete create/copy/resend/confirmed-revoke controls?

Is the 45-file manifest complete for this boundary, and are notifications, custom roles, SSO, SCIM, assignment/comments, billing, product AI agents, code review, repositories, and pull requests still absent?

decision_contract.pass: Every manifest hash and required check passes, no actionable P0-P3 finding remains, and the reviewer returns explicit PASS with Done eligibility limited to implementation output.
decision_contract.fail: Any actionable P0-P3 correctness, security, privacy, accessibility, evidence, manifest-completeness, or scope finding returns explicit FAIL; CT-136 must remain In Progress and be remediated/resealed.

reviewer_instructions: Operate read-only. Do not edit files or Control Tower. Verify the sealed manifest before and after checks, run all required commands (using scoped emulator/registry escalation if necessary), inspect Planning and prior CT-133/134/135 evidence, perform independent adversarial probes, rank every actionable finding P0-P3 with exact file/line and a reproducible counterexample, and return explicit PASS or FAIL plus Done eligibility.
